alt: Intrinsic muscles of the foot - one dorsal (extensor digitorum brevis) + four plantar layers (abductor hallucis/digiti minimi/FDB superficially, quadratus plantae/lumbricals next, FHB/FDMB/adductor hallucis third, plantar/dorsal interossei deepest). Mostly innervated by medial + lateral plantar nerves.
